structured_output.what_is_happening: ONCE (Oncepay) is a pump.fun token about 45 minutes old, still on the bonding curve at about $12k market cap. It is up about 240% in 1 hour on about $28k volume from 216 unique buyers, and is sitting near its all-time high (~$12.7k). The project pitches a utility idea: a live dashboard that reads pump.fun's "fee sharing config can only be updated once" rule and routes a coin's creator fees to an X handle. The website is live and shows on-chain scan figures. Beyond the project's own site and X handle, I found no outside discussion anywhere.

narrative.description: A dev-tool/utility story about pump.fun creator-fee assignment: showing which mints have already spent their one-time fee config, and assigning fees to X handles. It is niche, technically literate and insider-focused. It is not a meme or news event.
narrative.why_spreading: Nothing shows it spreading outside the pump.fun trading flow. Volume looks like normal new-coin curve trading plus bundled buys. Searches found no posts, news or community mentions.

token_connection.why_this_token: The project site oncepay.fun names this exact contract as $ONCE, and the packet lists no same-name or same-ticker tokens.

authenticity.evidence: GMGN tags 91 wallets as bundlers, and top bundler traders account for 32%. 45 fresh wallets (23% rate). Creator status is 'creator_close', so the dev has exited, and the creator holds 0%. The coin is flagged as a community takeover. Only 2 smart wallets, no KOL wallets, no paid boosts. The dev wallet was funded from MEXC, and this is its first launch. X profile inaccessible (403). Web searches for the contract, the name and the handle found nothing.
authenticity.uncertainty: I could not see X posts, so real organic X attention may exist without me finding it. The high bundler count could be how the launch was set up rather than a sign of coordinated dumping.

structural_risks: Very small bonding-curve depth (~58 virtual SOL), so price is very sensitive to moves both ways
Heavy bundler presence (91 wallets, top bundler traders 32%) is supply that could be sold into the curve
Dev has already exited (creator_close), and the coin is marked as a community takeover
3.75% of supply sits in a Streamflow vault
Only 55-174 holders, depending on the data source

structured_output.counterargument: At $12k, a double only needs about $24k market cap, which is a small absolute inflow on the curve. The site is unusually polished and technical, which could attract builder types on crypto X or a pump.fun-ecosystem retweet. Buys are running ahead of sells (m5 43/24), the price is at its all-time high, and a creator-fee-routing tool is a live topic in the pump.fun community. Momentum toward graduation could easily carry it through 2x.
unknowns: The X account's age, follower count and posts
Whether the bundler wallets are still holding or already selling
Whether any pump.fun or ecosystem figure has engaged with it

source_coverage.notes: Contract-address search returned only unrelated results. site:x.com search returned unrelated OnePay accounts. The X profile fetch returned 403. The site is live and names this contract. DexScreener API data was confirmed live.

structured_output.thesis: This is a real-looking but niche utility narrative with no outside attention found. The coin is dominated by bundler wallets, and the dev has already exited. The tiny market cap makes a 2x mechanically possible, but the most likely path is a fade as bundled supply is sold into the curve. Both outcomes carry substantial probability; I lean fade.
